task.title: Entitlement conditions not met — MPS claim

step.cmd: Verbally communicate the decision to the client
In NWS, create a ROD as follows:

ul.li: Comments: Type “Non-referred training — D61 from w/c [XXXX-X] to [XXXX-X].”
Details: Document the decision and rationale according to the Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy . Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy

step.cmd: In FTS, determine if there is an outstanding registration number for the training issue:

ul.li: If yes, go to step 4.

If no, select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and assign one as follows:
Action: Select Assign .
Claim Source: Select 3 - Mail/Revised decision .
Service Unit: Select 1 .
Decision type: Select 3 - Revised .
Select Update .

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) to inform IPOC to impose a disentitlement as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Memo (MPS): Check the box.
Contentious: Select 2 - Yes .
Complete: Select D - No .
Select Update .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
BPC: Select the appropriate BPC.
Work item: Select 93 - Manual Pay System .
Work Type: Select 30 - New information on a manual pay claim .
Remarks line 1: Type “Urgent request.”

Remarks line 2: Select the appropriate option:
If the end date is known, type “D61 from w/c [XXXX-X] to w/c [XXXX-X].”
If the end date is not known, type “D61 from w/c [XXXX-X] to 9999-9.”
Remarks line 3: Type “Training ID 90. Start date [XXXX]. End date [XXXX].”
Remarks line 4: Type “The client is not entitled to collect benefits for the non-referred training period.”
Remarks line 5: Enter your first name and last name.
Decision Type: Select 3 - Revised .
Contentious: Select 2 - Yes .
Complete: Select C - Yes .
Select Update .

step.cmd: Select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and transfer the registration number to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Action: Select Change registration flag .
Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .
Select Update .

step.cmd: In ACS, create and send the N-00-00-00 letter. Based on the claim information, select all of the required attributes, including the following:

ul.li: Special benefits denied (3065)

If the BT was family caregiver for children, select Family caregiver benefits for children denied - D61/D62/D63/Free text (11282) .
Select D61 - Not entitled to family caregiver benefits for children - Various reasons (11283) .
Select D61 - Client does not provide care or support to the critically Ill or injured child .
Select Indefinite/Definite/Multiple Disentitlement dates (2485) .
Select the appropriate dates from the drop down calendar.

If the BT was family caregiver for adults, select Family caregiver benefits for adults denied - D61/D62/D63 / Free Text (11281) .
Select D61 - Not entitled to family caregiver benefits for adults - Various reasons (11276) .
Select D61 - Client does not provide care or support to the critically ill or injured adult .
Select Indefinite/Definite/Multiple Disentitlement dates (2485) .
Select the appropriate dates from the drop down calendar.
Overpayment messages (2452) .
Right to Request a Reconsideration (no Blank Option) (4169): Select Right to Request a Reconsideration .
This letter replaces or Footnote (2365): Type “You have not proven that you are caring for your family member while attending a course of instruction on your own initiative.”

step.cmd: In NWS, complete the WI for the training issue.
